Subject guide

Live movement programs and wellbeing programs

Compare movement and wellbeing programs by level, requirements, and teaching approach. Choose a schedule that fits your week.

Explore current programs↗

Begin with the activity and the level

Movement, yoga, fitness, and related subjects can vary widely in pace and physical demands. Read the description and requirements carefully. Look for concrete information about what the sessions involve instead of choosing from a broad promise about how you will feel afterward.

Choose a setting where you can participate

For an online session, check the space and equipment needed and whether you can follow the provider comfortably on your device. For an in-person program, review the venue details and travel time. The right setting depends on the activity and your own circumstances.

Ask the questions that affect your decision

If a requirement is unclear, message the provider about the program before booking. Describe the practical question you need answered, such as equipment, pace, or expected experience. A program description is not a personal assessment, and participation should fit your individual needs.

Read the schedule beyond the first date

Check whether you are choosing a single session or a program with several meetings. The schedule lists those sessions together. Think about the time you can set aside consistently and any preparation the provider requests. Announcements and reminders help you stay informed if the program changes.

Before you choose

A few things to check

  • Level and physical requirements
  • Space and equipment
  • Venue or online setup
  • The full session schedule

Current programs, prices, and dates are available in the app.

Choosing your program

Good questions
to ask.

Does beginner mean suitable for everyone?

No. A level describes the program’s intended starting point. Read its requirements and ask the provider about the activity before deciding whether it fits your needs.

Is equipment provided?

Check the materials and venue information. Online and in-person programs may have different expectations, and equipment should not be assumed to be included.
